name: session-summary
description: Recap a session as a table row per main request the owner made, each with an honest status, then a block naming whatever still needs them.

interface.shortDescription: What you asked for, where each one stands, and what still needs you.
interface.longDescription: Reads the session's own requests and returns a table, one row per main request, written the way you asked for it, each carrying an honest status: done, partly done, blocked, waiting on you, dropped, or answered. Below the table, a block names whatever still needs your input or action.
defaultPrompt: What did I ask for, and where does it stand?
Recap this chat before I close it
